recipe.title: French Toast

steps.text: Whisk together Egg Mixture in a bowl. Vigorous whisk = avoid cinnamon floating on top.
steps.label: Make egg mixture

steps.text: Melt 15g / 1 tbsp butter in a non stick skillet over medium heat.
steps.label: Melt butter

steps.text: Dunk a piece of bread quickly into the egg mixture, coating both sides. Place in pan. Repeat with more slices to fill the pan, but don’t crowd it (do 2 or 3 at a time).
steps.label: Coat bread

steps.text: Cook for 2 ½ - 3 minutes on each side until the surface is golden, then transfer to serving plates.
steps.label: Cook bread

steps.text: Add more butter into the pan and cook remaining bread.
steps.label: Cook remaining

steps.text: Serve with butter and plenty of maple syrup, and Macerated Strawberries if using!
steps.label: Serve

steps.text: Toss strawberries with sugar, set aside for 20 minutes+. The strawberries will soften and sweat, and create a bit of syrup.
steps.label: Macerate strawberries
steps.doneness_cue: The strawberries will soften and sweat, and create a bit of syrup.

notes: Ingredients and method taken from the linked RecipeTin Eats JSON-LD. I preserved ingredient names and prep notes as stated; the recipeYield contained both "2" and "2 - 3 people" so I placed the latter into yield_text and left servings null. The macerated strawberries are provided as an optional HowToSection in the source; I set that step as optional and attached it to the Serve step.
